AssetCatalog.description: Normative precision and maximums for v2 money. BTC amounts are integer satoshis. USDC and USDT use 6 decimal places.

CountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Case-insensitive; normalized to uppercase.

CursorPageQuery.description: Cursor page query. Unknown query fields are rejected. `limit` is not a JSON number.

cursor.description: Opaque unpadded base64url cursor from a previous page. Do not parse it.

limit.description: Page size as a decimal integer string from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

ErrorBody.description: Safe error. `message` is copied from the catalog. Exception text, partner payloads, and stack traces are never included.

const.message: Something went wrong. Try again shortly.
Too many requests. Try again shortly.
This is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
You do not have access to this.
This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request.
This Idempotency-Key is already in progress.
The request could not be read.
The request conflicts with the current state.
This endpoint is no longer available.

ErrorCatalog.description: Stable machine codes for v2. Branch on `code` and `status`. `message` is a fixed safe sentence and is not a stable identifier.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine code. See ErrorCatalog for the HTTP status and safe message.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Failed v2 response. There is no `data` field. error.message is a fixed catalog sentence. Stack traces and internal errors are never included.

details.message: Amount must be a decimal string.

FieldIssue.description: One safe field error. `message` does not include the rejected value.

IdempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key: 8–200 characters from A–Z, a–z, 0–9, underscore, dot, colon, and hyphen. The key is validated only; it is not stored by this layer.

Money.description: Money amount. `amount` is a base-10 decimal string, never a JSON number. Floats, NaN, Infinity, exponents, signs, thousands separators, and leading zeros are rejected. Zero and values above the asset maximum are rejected. Currency is case-insensitive and normalized to uppercase. The canonical amount pads the fraction to the asset precision. BTC is an integer number of sats; EUR allows 2 decimal places; GBP allows 2 decimal places; GHS allows 2 decimal places; KES allows 2 decimal places; NGN allows 2 decimal places; USD allows 2 decimal places; USDC allows 6 decimal places; USDT allows 6 decimal places.

currency.description: Asset code. Any ASCII case is accepted and normalized to uppercase.

Money.title: Money

PageEnvelope.description: Successful cursor page. Items are in `data`; the cursor is in `meta`.

PageMeta.description: Cursor page metadata. `next_cursor` is null when `has_more` is false.

Phone.description: Phone number normalized to E.164 (`+` and 7–15 digits). Spaces, dashes, dots, parentheses, and a 00 prefix are accepted. National numbers without a country code are rejected.

ProviderMovement.description: Normalized bridge movement. Executable transaction data, secrets, and redirect tokens are not included.
ProviderMovement.title: ProviderMovement

ProviderQuote.description: Normalized swap or bridge quote. Executable transaction data and provider payloads are not included.
ProviderQuote.title: ProviderQuote

SuccessEnvelope.description: Successful v2 response. There is no `error` field.

data.description: Operation result. Each route narrows this schema.

info.description: Shared v2 contract for payouts, quotes, buys, sells, swaps, and collections. Each operation is one path. Responses use data, error, and meta.request_id. Amounts are decimal strings. Unknown fields are rejected. Idempotency-Key is validated here. Replay and conflict storage is opt-in on the HTTP layer. Error messages are fixed catalog sentences and never include stack traces or internal errors.
